assumptions.choice: Buy size is available cash divided by current close adjusted for the feed commission rate.
assumptions.reason: This targets 100% of available capital while reserving funds for the specified commission.

assumptions.choice: Crossing the Upper channel means close changes from at-or-below Upper to above Upper; crossing below Lower means close changes from at-or-above Lower to below Lower.
assumptions.reason: Implemented with Backtrader CrossOver using close price and each channel boundary.
